name: Victor White
source: Victor White is one of the few original best-selling authors who managed to survive the current trend of corporate meddling by publishers. Acclaimed for his science fiction and fantasy novels, he's been building a name for himself for almost a decade, and even though he's far from a super-star, he is admired and respected in the right circles. One of his current projects is kickstarting an independent literary magazine.
